note: Human adjudication of the key judgements produced by the rule scorer. The scorer re-derives every grade on each run, so a human verdict must be recorded here as durable input; a manual edit to historical-grades.jsonl would be overwritten on the next rescore. Only the reviewMethod/reviewer/adjudicatedAt fields are asserted - the judgement itself is the scorer's output, and a mismatch between this file and the scorer is a failure, not an override.
